items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I think one of the best things we did is our first album, “Laura.” ... Jeanne and I would dig more of the Silvers ... we did it at a house party in Stockholm and it got to be something that we would occasionally do as an encore.

ctx.x: So do you recall the accompaniment that you came up with, especially if you were a Beatles fan, was rather jarring and do you recall coming up with that and what Jeanne — did she have trouble singing to it? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Well I’ll try to ask her tonight in my dreams. I don’t know it just hit [plays piano]. I was hearing Monk at the time and I think Chris Connor covered that piece. That’s so long ago, we did it at a house party in Stockholm and it got to be something that we would occasionally do as an encore. Maybe we thought at the beginning we were, I hate to use this word, slumming — we know the Beatles are marvelous, well presented group. But Jeanne and I would dig more of the Silvers and other groups. So but we’re talking…
Well if you did “A Hard Day’s Night” one day for an event and then the next day you did it again, would it be appreciably different?
